bridge_purpose: Tie player principal, permissions/admin, command response, and commands/replies planning docs to one fail-closed vocabulary before any public ABI.

shared_principal_vocabulary.required_meaning: principal_handle is an opaque copied principal value only; it is never sufficient by itself to authorize permissions, command dispatch, response targeting, lookup, persistence, mutation, or return override
principal_generation is the generation/invalidation discriminator required with principal_handle except for a separately reviewed callback-local-only contract
principal_scope_flags is the explicit scope discriminator for callback-local, process-local, or separately promoted wider scope; unsupported or mismatched scope fails closed

required_fail_closed_conditions: commands/replies response shortcut before promoted identity and permissions/admin
required_bridge_behaviors: principal_handle, principal_generation, and principal_scope_flags must appear together in any future command, permission, or response payload that consumes player identity
principal_handle alone never authorizes
permissions/admin cannot return allow from command text, operator config, plugin input, or missing runtime principal observation
permission allow requires policy_source_id, policy_source_generation, authority_kind, authority_generation, and policy_epoch provenance
operator-config authority is recognized but not allow-capable until separately promoted
plugin input and command callbacks cannot self-attest permission authority or policy provenance
command/chat response targeting cannot create principal or permission claims
command/chat response path requires copied response payload, nonzero plugin_owner_token, owner-scoped handles, and promoted identity/permissions before any directed response
minimal ChatMessageEvent is passive copied input only and cannot authorize replies, send-chat, broadcast, moderation, identity, permissions, or response delivery
raw ProcessEvent callbacks cannot authorize replies, send-chat, broadcast, moderation, identity, permissions, or response delivery
static thunk orientation cannot authorize replies, send-chat, broadcast, moderation, identity, permissions, or response delivery
commands/replies cannot dispatch when permission result is deny or unknown
commands/replies cannot dispatch from missing permission policy_epoch or missing command_chat_response_path promotion
commands/replies planning cannot bypass promoted player identity, promoted permissions/admin, or promoted command_chat_response_path
commands/replies cannot imply replies, send-chat, broadcast, moderation, storage, or admin mutation
permission or command rate-limit exhaustion fails closed
malformed UTF-8, oversize messages or commands, and unsupported command source kinds fail closed
missing or zero plugin_owner_token fails closed for every future owner-token bridge operation
missing capability fails closed and no capability bit is reserved by this bridge
legacy CallProcessEvent debug access is not a command, reply, response, permission, or principal bridge
ArkServerApi, ArkApi, AseApi, and NextGenPlugins names may inform demand only and cannot provide offsets, layouts, vtables, code, control flow, or ABI semantics

bridge_ergonomics_flow.required_boundary: copied ChatMessageEvent text is request input only and cannot establish principal identity, permission authority, dispatch authority, reply/send-chat/broadcast/moderation authority, or response delivery
plugin-local parsing can shape private plugin intent only and cannot become a public command router, public parser, ArkApi/AseApi parser compatibility claim, or dispatch ordering claim

future copied command payload must carry nonzero plugin_owner_token plus principal_handle, principal_generation, principal_scope_flags, permission_policy_epoch, source_kind, and normalized command name before dispatch can be considered
permission query must fail closed on deny, unknown, missing provenance, stale principal generation, unsupported scope, malformed action, oversize command, or unsupported source_kind

future response request remains copied intent only and cannot imply reply/send-chat/broadcast/moderation delivery until promoted player identity, promoted permissions/admin, and command_chat_response_path are separately promoted

forbidden_public_contract: public CallProcessEvent command or reply path
public static thunk orientation response path
public commands/replies response shortcut before promoted identity and permissions/admin
principal or permission claims from command text
principal or permission claims from operator config
non_claims: This bridge does not add public header symbols.
This bridge does not reserve public capability bits.
This bridge does not define a response ABI.
This bridge does not promote player identity, permissions/admin, command/chat response path, or commands/replies.
This bridge does not authorize runtime wiring, server validation, live probes, public command routing, replies, send-chat, moderation, admin mutation, storage, lookup, mutation, or return override.
This bridge is a planning-only fail-closed vocabulary guardrail.
